review.title: Review dependency scope
review.acceptance: allowedPaths remains the sole write, collision and staging surface while review fingerprints, stale-review checks, approvals and the DONE gate bind to allowedPaths union reviewDependencies; two tasks with disjoint allowedPaths and a shared reviewDependency can be active simultaneously, and editing that shared dependency invalidates both reviews; tasks without reviewDependencies behave identically to before

repo-validate.evidence: npm run check exit 0 under pinned Node 22 resolved via npx node@22, including ai:validate, repo:validate, env:validate across all three modes, test:scripts, lint, typecheck, test and build.

unit.evidence: npm run ai:test exit 0 under pinned Node 22: scripts/test-ai-control-plane.mjs, including six new regressions proving disjoint allowedPaths with a shared reviewDependency stay concurrently claimable, that editing the shared dependency invalidates both approvals, that a dependency cannot be written or staged, that overlapping reviewDependencies never create a claim conflict including the asymmetric case, that allowedPaths is implicitly inside the review surface, and that a task without reviewDependencies fingerprints byte-identically to before.
